_about: LGIC_ENFORCE round 14 fixed input. THE ONE CARRIER of the record shape (S85). TWO cells that 1.0.0_SA_CTO's round-13 analysis @cf0cf68868 ordered NOT to be paired: 'they share a file and nothing else, and A JOINT CELL WILL REPORT THE EASIER ONE.' One is a REPAIR on the report's rendering; the other is a MEASUREMENT of a grain ambiguity. Separate cells, separate orders, separate records, one issuance.

scope_source.the_recut: (1) S101's rendering substitution as a REPAIR cell ON THE REPORT -- the producer is correct at the values so nothing upstream moves, and cut it to make both columns render through ONE path, NOT to 'fix' the current column, or the asymmetry returns the next time a third column is added. (2) S102's 1449-vs-1303 as a MEASUREMENT cell. DO NOT PAIR THEM.
scope_source.round13_stands: LGIC_ENFORCE round 13 STANDS; no PRD addendum owed; endpoint outcomes unchanged; scope 0 open of 155.

cell_1_the_rendering_repair.claim: held -- 3.0.0_SA_CVO's S101, measured at L9, HEAD ccbf4ac3cb
cell_1_the_rendering_repair.what_S101_found: the r13 report renders a brace as a PARENTHESIS in the `current` column ONLY. Across 3264 table rows the CANONICAL column carries 1303 braces and 0 paren-wrapped tokens; the CURRENT column carries 0 braces and 8 paren-wrapped tokens.
cell_1_the_rendering_repair.why_it_is_worse_than_hiding_a_value: the substitution is SYSTEMATIC AND ASYMMETRIC, so the same token renders one way in one column and the other way in the column beside it -- it MANUFACTURES AN APPARENT DIFFERENCE between two cells that are EQUAL AT THE VALUES.
cell_1_the_rendering_repair.what_it_cost: the grader's FIRST PASS on the cause verdict's load-bearing evidence returned 0 of 5 and would have been a FALSE FINDING against the cell. THE COST IS BORNE BY THE GRADER, NOT THE AUTHOR: every check of that evidence, done against the artifact the record points at, returns a false negative.
cell_1_the_rendering_repair.the_shape_of_the_repair_and_it_is_the_wh: BOTH COLUMNS RENDER THROUGH ONE PATH. NOT 'fix the current column' -- the CTO's reason, verbatim: 'or the asymmetry returns the next time a third column is added.'

WHAT_THIS_SEAT_FOUND_AT_THE_CUT_AND_NEIT.claim: measured -- read at PLACEHOLDER_POPULATION_TABLE_R13.md:7-16 @f658dc53cb, printed bytes
WHAT_THIS_SEAT_FOUND_AT_THE_CUT_AND_NEIT.the_substitution_is_DELIBERATE_AND_DECLA: the table's own preamble states it: `current` and `where` have their `{`/`}` rendered as `(`/`)` SO THAT a pre-existing literal template brace in the OBSERVED name is never double-counted -- 'the `canonical` cell is the ONLY column left with real `{` `}` bytes'. The column header reads `current(escaped)`.
WHAT_THIS_SEAT_FOUND_AT_THE_CUT_AND_NEIT.so_the_escaping_IS_LOAD_BEARING: it is what let the round-13 arm identify the population by which column carries brace bytes. A repair that merely deletes it BREAKS THE r13 ARM'S DISCRIMINATOR while looking like a tidy fix.
WHAT_THIS_SEAT_FOUND_AT_THE_CUT_AND_NEIT.what_this_does_NOT_do: it does not make S101 wrong. The asymmetry is real, it manufactured a false negative for the grader, and declaring a hazard in prose is not removing it -- a reader checking the record's evidence against the artifact still gets 0 of 5.
WHAT_THIS_SEAT_FOUND_AT_THE_CUT_AND_NEIT.what_it_DOES_do_to_the_cut: the criterion cannot grade the two columns' COUNTS against each other -- two columns hold DIFFERENT CONTENT, so `canonical_braces == current_braces` is a bar NO CORRECT ARTIFACT CAN MEET. This seat drafted exactly that bar and repaired it before issuing. THE ASYMMETRY LIVES IN THE RULE, so the rule is what is graded: ONE renderer, ONE rule over EVERY column in the table's own denominator, a WITNESS token rendering alike in two columns, and a stated population_discriminator for the job the escaping used to do.

cell_1_the_rendering_repair.nothing_upstream_moves: the PRODUCER is correct at the values (S101 resolved it at the source: the five rows' producing file carries '{dim_name}' on 10 of 10 matching lines and '(dim_name)' on 0, over a printed denominator of 71 tracked files). This cell changes RENDERING only.

cell_2_the_grain_measurement.what_S102_found: the per-token row counts sum to 1449 against a population of 1303 rows, and the record discloses the overlap NOWHERE. A row may carry several placeholder tokens, so the column is PER-TOKEN and the headline is PER-ROW -- two different grains printed adjacent with the same word, `rows`.
cell_2_the_grain_measurement.absent_disclosures_measured: the phrases 'more than one', 'multiple', 'overlap', 'sum' and 'may carry' are each ABSENT from the record.
cell_2_the_grain_measurement.explicitly_not_a_defect_in_the_measureme: S102 says so itself -- the figures are CORRECT and the field name `rows` is accurate PER TOKEN; the cause verdict and the producer attribution do not depend on it, and 1303 is the figure the delta uses. WHAT IS MISSING IS THE SENTENCE that stops a reader adding the column and concluding the two figures disagree.
cell_2_the_grain_measurement.so_the_cell_measures_the_multiplicity: how many rows carry more than one token, the distribution, and the arithmetic that reconciles 1449 with 1303 -- stated so the two figures can never again be read as disagreeing.

why_they_are_not_paired.claim: held -- the CTO's instruction, and this seat's own reading of it
why_they_are_not_paired.instruction: DO NOT PAIR THEM: they share a file and nothing else, and a joint cell will report the easier one.
why_they_are_not_paired.how_the_cut_honours_it: two cells, two orders, two records, two workers on two slots. NEITHER order mentions the other's criterion, so no cell can satisfy its own bar by doing the other's work.
why_they_are_not_paired.the_input_collision_and_its_fix: cell 1 changes how reports RENDER, and cell 2 READS the r13 report. If cell 1 regenerated that report mid-round, cell 2's input would move underneath it. So CELL 2 PINS ITS INPUT BY COMMIT -- the r13 report at `c05f9f9fc9` -- and states that pin in its record. The two then run in parallel with no ordering between them.

the_bar_this_round_carries.claim: held -- the CTO's cut-time bar, applied to every criterion below
the_bar_this_round_carries.statement: Before a criterion ships, ask: CAN A CORRECT ARTIFACT SATISFY THIS? Where the honest answer is no, THE CRITERION IS THE DEFECT, NOT THE CELL.
the_bar_this_round_carries.applied_here: each criterion was built against a hand-made CORRECT record driven as a POSITIVE-SATISFIABILITY arm; the repair cell's arm accepts ANY single rendering path (it does not dictate which -- escape-everywhere and escape-nowhere BOTH pass, proven by two positive arms); the measurement cell's arm accepts an honest 'no rows carry more than one token' result as readily as a large overlap.
the_bar_this_round_carries.it_bit_at_this_cut: the first draft of the repair criterion graded `canonical_braces == current_braces`, which NO CORRECT ARTIFACT CAN MEET because the two columns hold different content. It was caught by reading the r13 table's own preamble before issuing, and replaced with the RULE-shaped bar. That is a fifth instance of the shape the bar was written for, and the first one caught by the ISSUER rather than by the worker being graded.

stale_proof_bar.claim: held -- the repaired predicate with both residuals
stale_proof_bar.statement: SET EQUALITY against the proofs that could actually be stale; the COUNT is informational; a failed retrieval RAISES; ONE ordered git log over all watched paths.

not_in_this_round_and_why.changing the producer: S101 resolved at the source that the producer is CORRECT at the values. This round changes rendering only; touching the producer would be repairing something measured as sound.
not_in_this_round_and_why.re-opening round 13: its verdicts stand. S101 and S102 are observations ABOUT the artifact and the record, not about the measurement, and S102 says in terms that the cause verdict does not depend on it.
not_in_this_round_and_why.pairing the two cells: refused by the analysis and by this cut.
